rows.grounds: bhitti+madhye = in the middle of the wall

items.question: Where may the practitioner place the consecrated object for worship?
premises: placement may be in wall middle
placement may be in sleeping place
placement is in one's own space
items.inference: The verse permits placing the object either in the middle of a wall or in one's own sleeping place.
uncertainties: exact object being placed is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: Having placed it in the middle of a wall, or in one's own sleeping place.
